summary: Verified the roaming-signatures BUG-FIX control plus two new features (per-employee Pousser button, background M365 sync with progress bar). Logged in as admin, opened /app/m365: roaming-card renders with 'Désactivées ✅' message and button-toggle-roaming visible ('Réactiver le roaming'). Toggled it → success toast 'Signatures itinérantes réactivées.' captured; toggled back → final state verified via API GET /api/m365/roaming = {postponed:true} (ending state = DISABLED as required). Clicked button-sync-fiches-m365: sync-progress bar appeared showing 'Synchronisation en cours… 1 / 1' (only 1 linked fiche = s.lynch), and GET /api/m365/sync/status confirmed {running:false,total:1,done:1,synced:1,failed:[]}. On /app/employees, s.lynch row shows M365 badge and button-push-employee-{id}; click produced toast 'Signature poussée à Simon Lynch.'
critical_code_review_comments: Roaming-card copy is clear and uses correct semantics (Désactivées = safe state where SigChamp signatures are visible). Nice.

sync-progress bar disappears as soon as running=false; that's fine, but consider keeping a 'Terminé (N synced / M failed)' summary for a few seconds so admins have a visual confirmation without needing the toast.
seed_data_creation: None. Ending roaming state left at postponed=true (disabled) as required.
context_for_next_testing_agent: M365 tenant has 1 linked fiche (s.lynch@champagneur.qc.ca). Roaming currently disabled (postponed=true) so pushed signatures are visible in New Outlook/OWA. button-push-employee-{id} works per-row on Employees page. Sync progress bar renders while background task runs and disappears when finished (~2-4s for 1 fiche).
rca of the issue: Original bug: pushed signature not visible in Outlook because tenant had roaming signatures enabled (PostponeRoamingSignaturesUntilLater=False), causing New Outlook/OWA to ignore Set-MailboxMessageConfiguration output. Fix: exposed roaming state via GET/POST /api/m365/roaming and added roaming-card + toggle in UI; main agent already set postponed=true on the live tenant. Verified via API: {"postponed":true}.
